load_mujoco_environment: load a mujoco environment by name with optional config and config overrides
get_default_config: get the default configuration for a named mujoco environment across all suites
get_domain_randomizer: get the domain randomizer function for a manipulation or locomotion environment
list_all_environments: list all available mujoco environment names across dm_control_suite, locomotion, and manipulation suites
validate_environment_name: validate whether a given environment name exists in the registry and raise an error if not
